_note: Session history the flagged cases assume. A g_* flag is what the engine records after a real earlier step in the SAME session; it cannot be served by a probe (the service refuses g_* registrations). So the harness performs the earlier step for real, with its own facts served like any case, and the engine sets the flag itself.

g_sensitive_data_accessed.action_description: bench prior step: read one customer record that contains personal data

g_persistent_mutation_made.action_description: bench prior step: update one record in the system of record

g_irreversible_action_taken.action_description: bench prior step: permanently purge one archived record
